newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico same-day peso reverses gains to close soft.
newsitem.headline: Mexico same-day peso reverses gains to close soft.

text.p: The same-day peso reversed early firmness to close soft on Thursday, due to end-of-month demand for dollars by local brokers, traders said.
"The market has been mixed, as it was yesterday. First we saw dollars flowing in due to lower U.S. long bond rates and then demand to close positions for the month," a trader said.
The same-day peso closed 0.4 of centavo weaker at 7.5250/7.5275 per dollar.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and 24-hour contracts had also reversed early firmness and were respectively 0.9 and 0.2 of a centavo weaker at 7.5440/7.5465 and 7.5280/7.5310 per dollar.
